managed-collections-in-hot-path.why: Managed collections allocate on the heap and trigger GC in per-frame code paths.
managed-collections-in-hot-path.avoid: Dictionary<K,V>, List<T>, HashSet<T> in per-frame code
managed-collections-in-hot-path.prefer: Pre-allocated arrays or NoZ engine collections

ui-style-allocation.why: UI styles are applied every frame during UpdateUI. Allocating them per-frame defeats the immediate-mode pattern.
ui-style-allocation.avoid: new ContainerStyle { ... } inside UpdateUI or per-frame methods
ui-style-allocation.prefer: static readonly style structs at class level

immediate-mode-ui.name: Immediate-mode UI
immediate-mode-ui.description: UI built every frame via NoZ ElementTree. Begin/End pairs, using-block scoping.

static-style-structs.name: Static style structs
static-style-structs.description: ContainerStyle, LabelStyle, etc. declared as static readonly at class level.

asset-registry.name: Asset registry
asset-registry.description: Asset.Load<T> pattern with binary format and cache.
